decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The cited sentence on its own only covers the unaffected case. The surrounding upgrade-guide section fills in the rest. [ev-43cc6d389282], [ev-528edacf0d9e] and [ev-19d4f84472e6] say the subject is the `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` and `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` flags and their YAML settings. They also give the change: both are removed, and the `path_prefix` under the `index` key of `period_config` replaces them. [ev-8ceba924ad20] and [ev-632a3911583a] say who is exposed: setups that set a key-prefix other than `index/` must set `path_prefix` to that value in every existing period config of that index type. The section never says outright what happens if an operator does nothing (by analogy with the shared-store case [ev-7d2769e8c602], probably lost access to the index), and the boltdb and tsdb flags may need to be two subjects, so confidence is low.
